July 6 Anna Pankow - 33 - operation last March very serious, still sickly sometime discouraged ....
Leo Fischer - 5 - lukemia - has had 3 blood-transf. since last Tuesday. Drs. have no hope .... On way home threatening from hospital (Harper) was enrolled perpetually in S.M.A.
